subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option:
The revised algorithm is ___ than the previous version, reducing load time by half.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence compares two versions of an algorithm, focusing on efficiency.
 
• When making comparisons between two entities, the comparative degree of the adjective is used.
 
• The comparative form of "efficient" is "**more efficient**."
 
• Thus, "**more efficient**" is the most suitable option to complete the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The revised algorithm is **more efficient** than the previous version, reducing load time by half."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "efficient"** – This is the base form of the adjective and is not suitable for comparisons.
 
• **Option 2: "most efficient"** – This is the superlative form and is used when comparing one entity to all others, which is not the case here.
 
• **Option 4: "efficiency"** – This is a noun and does not fit grammatically in the sentence.
